articles.title: Critical Drupal RCE Vulnerability Could Let Attackers Take Over Websites Without Authentication
articles.summary:
Drupal has released security updates for a critical remote code execution vulnerability that could let attackers take over affected websites without logging in. Tracked as CVE-2026-108097, the flaw affects the Field UI module in Drupal core. The Drupal Security Team published its warning on October 14, 2026. articles.title: Microsoft Says AI Agents Cannot Be Trusted and Could Become Insider Security Threats
articles.summary:
Microsoft warns organizations to treat AI agents as potential insider risks not because they are automatically malicious, but because they can access company data, apps, and tools and act on that access at high speed.
